Title: Azure SQL Data Warehouse: Enhanced loading, monitoring, and troubleshooting experience

Body.Content:
Azure SQL Data Warehouse has introduced new updates to the Azure portal and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS)​. These enhancements improve the overall experience when you're loading, monitoring, and developing SQL Data Warehouse.

For the Azure portal, improvements consist of:

  • Quick wizard to load your data with Azure Data Factory
  • Top-level resource blade to quickly allow you to manage your data warehouses
  • Provisioning experience with collation support of more than 3,800 supported collations
  • Troubleshoot blade to self-diagnose common issues
  • Task panel to execute common actions against SQL Data Warehouse
  • Query monitoring blade surfacing resource classes and concurrency slots

For SQL Server Management Studio, enhancements include these abilities:

  • Execute the Generate Scripts wizard for database users and user-defined functions
  • View your logical server name within the table properties of your database
  • Drop your database simply through the Object Explorer
  • Use templates for stored procedures and scalar-valued functions
